name: Kitchen View
description: A kitchen view for the wall tablet: today's and this week's meals from any Home Assistant calendar, recipes opened full screen from your recipe app and a cook mode that keeps the screensaver away while you cook. Works with any app that puts its meal plan in a Home Assistant calendar.
author: vednolacni

settings.title: Meal plan calendars
settings.description: Home Assistant calendar entities that hold the meal plan, such as the ones the Tandoor or Mealie integrations add.

fields.title: Calendar
fields.description: Pick a calendar entity, such as calendar.tandoor_meal_plan.

fields.title: Label
fields.description: Optional. Shown with this calendar's meals, such as Lunch or School.

settings.title: Days to show
settings.description: Today and the days after it.

settings.title: Split the meal type from the dish
settings.description: Show an event called "Dinner: Lasagna" as Dinner above Lasagna.

settings.title: Recipe app address
settings.description: Home page of your recipe app, such as http://192.168.1.20:8080. It opens full screen as its own page, not in a frame, so its login keeps working. Meals without a recipe link open it too.

settings.title: Recipe search address
settings.description: Optional, for meals whose event has no link: a search page with {title} where the dish goes, such as http://192.168.1.20:8080/search/?query={title}.

settings.title: Cook mode
settings.description: Keep the screensaver away while a recipe is open. Closing the recipe ends it.

settings.title: Longest cooking session
settings.description: Only for Kiosk Satellite releases that cannot hold the screensaver for a page. Cook mode then ends after this long or when you press End cooking.

settings.title: Panel title
settings.description: Leave empty for Meal plan in the panel's language.

settings.title: Close when the screensaver starts
settings.description: The way the built-in calendar and camera views go away when the kiosk is idle.
